about: Underline main test set. 'must' = groups of words/numbers; the verified answer must contain at least one option from EVERY group (numbers are compared after '30 days' == 'thirty days' and '5,000' == '5000'). 'pages' = pages where the proof is. answerable=false means the right behaviour is 'not found'.

health.source: IFFCO-Tokio General Insurance, Arogya Sanjeevani Policy wording (UIN IFFHLIP20161V011920), public PDF from iffcotokio.co.in

rent.source: Government of Jersey, Model Residential Tenancy Agreement, public PDF from gov.je

offer.source: Synthetic offer letter written for this test (fictional company and person)

questions.question: What is the limit for room rent?
questions.expected: Up to 2% of the sum insured, maximum Rs. 5,000 per day.

questions.question: How much will the policy pay for cataract treatment?
questions.expected: Up to 25% of sum insured or Rs. 40,000, whichever is lower, per eye per policy year.

questions.question: What is the waiting period for pre-existing diseases?
questions.expected: 36 months of continuous coverage (3 years).

questions.question: How much co-payment do I have to pay on a claim?
questions.expected: 5% of the admissible claim amount, on every claim.

questions.question: What is the maximum amount paid for a road ambulance?
questions.expected: Up to Rs. 2,000 per hospitalisation.

questions.question: For how many days after discharge are medical expenses covered?
questions.expected: 60 days from the date of discharge.

questions.question: Is hernia surgery covered from the first day?
questions.expected: No. Hernia has a 24-month waiting period.

questions.question: How long is the free look period?
questions.expected: 30 days from the date of receiving the policy document.

questions.question: By how much does the cumulative bonus increase for a claim-free year?
questions.expected: 5% per claim-free year, up to a maximum of 50% of the sum insured.

questions.question: Is treatment taken in another country covered?
questions.expected: No. Treatment must be taken in India only.

questions.question: What is the ICU charge limit per day?
questions.expected: Up to 5% of sum insured, maximum Rs. 10,000 per day.

questions.question: What is the yearly premium for a 35-year-old?
questions.expected: Not in the document (premium amounts are not stated).

questions.question: Is there a discount for buying this policy online?
questions.expected: Not in the document.

questions.question: How much notice must the landlord give before increasing the rent?
questions.expected: At least 2 months' prior written notice.

questions.question: How often can the landlord increase the rent?
questions.expected: Only after at least 1 year has passed since the rent was last set or increased.

questions.question: Within how many days must the landlord put the deposit into the protection scheme?
questions.expected: Within 30 days after receiving the deposit.

questions.question: What interest is charged if the rent is paid late?
questions.expected: If rent is more than 14 days overdue, interest of 3% above the Bank of England base rate.

questions.question: Can the tenant smoke inside the property?
questions.expected: No. The tenant must not smoke or allow others to smoke in the property.

questions.question: How much notice must the tenant give to end a periodic tenancy?
questions.expected: At least 1 month's written notice.

questions.question: How much notice must the landlord give to end a periodic tenancy without giving a reason?
questions.expected: At least 1 year's written notice.

questions.question: Within how many days must the landlord give the tenant the condition report?
questions.expected: 2 signed copies within 7 days of completion.

questions.question: Who pays for the broadband internet connection?
questions.expected: Not in the document (services are left blank to fill in).

questions.question: How much stamp duty must be paid to register this agreement?
questions.expected: Not in the document.

questions.question: What is my total annual CTC?
How long is the probation period?
questions.expected: 6 months, which can be extended by up to 3 more months.

questions.question: What is the notice period after confirmation?
questions.expected: 60 days.

questions.question: How many days of paid annual leave do I get?
questions.expected: 24 days per calendar year.

questions.question: Do I have to pay back the joining bonus if I leave early?
questions.expected: Yes, in full, if you resign or are terminated for cause within 12 months of joining.

questions.question: How many days a week do I need to work from the office?
questions.expected: At least 3 days per week.

questions.question: What is the sum insured of the group health insurance?
questions.expected: Rs. 5,00,000 per year.

questions.question: Does the company give stock options (ESOPs)?
questions.expected: Not in the document.

questions.question: How much extra pay do I get for overtime hours?
questions.expected: Not in the document (only on-call weeks are paid, Rs. 4,000/week; overtime is not mentioned).
